data.narrative:
Floodbase is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Bessie Schwarz and Dr. Beth Tellman, having raised $17M to date. The Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable median peer analysis.

Given data constraints, the primary applicable valuation method is stage-progression analysis. Using the $17M total capital raised as a proxy for post-money valuation at Series A entry, a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to next-stage financing implies a valuation of $34M. This reflects the magnitude of equity value creation expected between Series A and subsequent institutional funding rounds in this sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $29M to $39M, centered on $34M. This range reflects uncertainty around (1) the precise entry valuation embedded in the $17M raised figure, (2) the applicability of a 2.0x multiplier to Floodbase's specific risk and growth profile relative to broader Climate & Energy stage norms, and (3) the absence of granular peer-level benchmarks. The primary sensitivity is to capital efficiency and time-to-Series B; tighter cash burn or accelerated revenue traction would support the upper range.
